failures.issue: At phone width the thick, high-contrast stripes read as a foreground pattern rather than quiet texture. across_options.issue: Header band adds a visible hairline outline to the Sold pill. The placement comparison therefore also changes the pill treatment. The missing money highlight after the amount moves onto white additionally introduces a D6 treatment, as recorded above.

Whole moment changes the divider above Ship by Tuesday from gray to white and removes the visible separator above the bottom navigation. These foreground/separator changes accompany the field-placement change.

No other material changes to the item, wording, amounts, action set, or content positions are visible. The texture variants retain the base composition; their changed line strength and visibility are the intended D5 difference.
